data.title: CHANGE
data.statement:
You're a shop manager and you need an algorithm to give the exact change for each customer with the fewest coins possible.
You must return the change, and the detail of the coins in the change, using the fewest coins as possible, in descending order.
If there is no change, return {{No coin to give back.}}
Assume there is an unlimited supply of each coin denomination.

data.inputDescription:
<<Line 1 :>> A float, the [[price]] of the article.
<<Line 2 :>> A float, the money [[paid]] by the customer.
<<Line 3 :>> An integer, the number of different [[coins]] you have.
<<[[n]] next lines:>> A float [[value]] for the value of a coin denomination, given in descending order, one line per coin denomination used.
data.outputDescription:
<<Line 1 :>> The change to give, with 2 decimal places, or {{No coin to give back.}} if no change is owed.
<<next lines :>>One line per [[value]] of coin used as change. Each line is the details of change given formatted like this: [[A]] {{coin}}({{s}}) of [[value]]{{$}} 
Where [[A]] is the number of coins. The plural form is only used when [[A]] is greater than 1.
The output format of [[value]] is:
• Output [[value]] without any decimal places if it is an integer.
• Otherwise, output [[value]] with the minimum number of decimal places required, without trailing zeros.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You're a shop manager and you need an algorithm to give the exact change for each customer with the fewest coins possible.
You must return the change, and the detail of the coins in the change, using the fewest coins as possible, in descending order.
If there is no change, return No coin to give back.
Assume there is an unlimited supply of each coin denomination.
Input
Line 1 : A float, the price of the article.
Line 2 : A float, the money paid by the customer.
Line 3 : An integer, the number of different coins you have.
n next lines: A float value for the value of a coin denomination, given in descending order, one line per coin denomination used.
Output
Line 1 : The change to give, with 2 decimal places, or No coin to give back. if no change is owed.
next lines :One line per value of coin used as change. Each line is the details of change given formatted like this: A coin(s) of value$
Where A is the number of coins. The plural form is only used when A is greater than 1.
The output format of value is:
• Output value without any decimal places if it is an integer.
• Otherwise, output value with the minimum number of decimal places required, without trailing zeros.
Constraints
It is always possible to make the exact change using the available coin denominations.
0.01 ≤ price ≤ 9999
1 ≤ paid ≤ 10000
price ≤ paid
2 ≤ coins ≤ 15
0.01 ≤ value ≤ 500
Example
Input
9.00
10.00
2
2.0
1.0
Output
1.00
1 coin of 1$
